name: GPMC 战略层大屏
description: 项目综合态势总览模板，面向集团领导的一屏全局态势感知。

actions.panelBodyTemplate:
面向集团领导，一屏判断项目是否健康、投资执行是否偏离、风险是否失控。
• 优先关注项目总数、在建、延期、高风险四组总览指标。
• 结合预算与执行、完成率趋势、事业部排名判断全局健康度。
• 从异常项目与专题聚焦区定位需要继续追问的管控专题。

面向集团领导，一屏判断项目是否健康、投资执行是否偏离、风险是否失控。

• 从异常项目与专题聚焦区定位需要继续追问的管控专题。

建议按“总览态势 → 问题专题 → 执行明细”的顺序讲解，不打断全局浏览。
• 先讲“延期项目”和“高风险项目”，再进入对应管控看板。
• 看板里的指标、榜单和清单继续下钻到执行层只读页面。
• 执行层只承载明细与跟进情况，不在演示中编辑数据。

→ 项目执行监控：查看延期 TOP10、里程碑与阻塞链路。
→ 质量信息与跟进：查看质量问题规模、闭环率与措施清单。
→ 技术状态与跟进：查看技术状态变更、签署率与未闭环项。
→ 成本与预算控制：查看预算执行、偏差和周期支出趋势。
→ 风险与预警中心：查看风险矩阵、分布与闭环情况。

metricNote.definition: 周期内有进度数据上报的不同项目数(去重)
metricNote.formula: 周期内出现过的不同项目编号去重计数
metricNote.scope: 进度信息汇总表中 plan_month 落在周期内的项目

sqlConfig.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.project_no) AS "项目总数", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN d.project_no END) AS "进行中项目", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete AND ((d.is_overdue_unchanged OR d.is_overdue_changed) AND NOT d.is_general_node) THEN d.project_no END) AS "延期项目" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

metricNote.definition: 存在未完成节点的项目数
metricNote.formula: 周期内未完成节点数 > 0 的项目编号去重计数
metricNote.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

sqlConfig.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.project_no) AS "项目总数", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN d.project_no END) AS "进行中项目", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete AND ((d.is_overdue_unchanged OR d.is_overdue_changed) AND NOT d.is_general_node) THEN d.project_no END) AS "延期项目" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

metricNote.definition: 存在超期未完成节点的项目数
metricNote.formula: 周期内 (超期未完成未变更 + 超期未完成已变更) > 0 的项目编号去重计数
metricNote.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制
metricNote.excelRef: (衍生)有超期未完成的项目计数

sqlConfig.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.project_no) AS "项目总数", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN d.project_no END) AS "进行中项目", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete AND ((d.is_overdue_unchanged OR d.is_overdue_changed) AND NOT d.is_general_node) THEN d.project_no END) AS "延期项目" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

metricNote.definition: 已到时间节点中,按时完成的节点占比
metricNote.formula: 按时完成节点数 ÷ (已到时间节点数 + 周期外完成节点数) × 100%
metricNote.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

sqlConfig.query: WITH p AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_due THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS due, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incomplete, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete AND d.is_high_risk THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hi_inc, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_milestone_node AND d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ms_ot, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_milestone_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ms_t, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_abnormal_pending AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abn, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_unchanged AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ov_unc, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_changed AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ov_chg, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete AND d.is_milestone_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inc_ms FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]) SELECT CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "按时完成率", CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((p.ov_unc+p.ov_chg)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "超期率", CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "异常率", CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100,2) END AS "里程碑按时率", CASE WHEN p.incomplete=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.hi_inc::numeric/p.incomplete::numeric*100,2) END AS "高风险未完成占比", ROUND((CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE (p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END))*0.3,2) AS "进度健康度", p.inc_ms*3+p.hi_inc*2+p.ov_unc*1 AS "风险预警指数" FROM p

metricNote.definition: 加权风险暴露指数,值越低风险越小
metricNote.formula: 未完成里程碑数 × 3 + 高风险未完成节点数 × 2 + 超期未完成节点数 × 1
metricNote.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

sqlConfig.query: WITH p AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_due THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS due, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incomplete, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete AND d.is_high_risk THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hi_inc, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_milestone_node AND d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ms_ot, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_milestone_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ms_t, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_abnormal_pending AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abn, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_unchanged AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ov_unc, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_changed AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ov_chg, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete AND d.is_milestone_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inc_ms FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]) SELECT CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "按时完成率", CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((p.ov_unc+p.ov_chg)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "超期率", CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100,2) END AS "异常率", CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100,2) END AS "里程碑按时率", CASE WHEN p.incomplete=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(p.hi_inc::numeric/p.incomplete::numeric*100,2) END AS "高风险未完成占比", ROUND((CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE (p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END))*0.3,2) AS "进度健康度", p.inc_ms*3+p.hi_inc*2+p.ov_unc*1 AS "风险预警指数" FROM p

SELECT d.plan_month AS "月份", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "按时完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "超期完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "未完成" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]] GROUP BY d.plan_month ORDER BY d.plan_month

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "按时完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "超期完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "未完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_pending_normal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "正常待完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_abnormal_pending AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "不正常待变更" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

sqlConfig.query: SELECT SUM(s.open_cat_design) AS "设计", SUM(s.open_cat_process) AS "工艺", SUM(s.open_cat_management) AS "管理", SUM(s.open_cat_component) AS "元器件", SUM(s.open_cat_operation) AS "操作", SUM(s.open_cat_outsource) AS "外协外购", SUM(s.open_cat_software) AS "软件", SUM(s.open_cat_other) AS "其他" FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND s.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

SELECT project_no AS "项目编号", subsystem AS "分系统", node_task AS "节点任务", node_type AS "节点类型", owner AS "负责人", dept AS "责任科室", completion_status AS "完成情况", risk_level AS "风险等级", plan_date AS "计划时间", delay_days AS "延期天数" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 WHERE plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]] AND is_incomplete = true ORDER BY delay_days DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

metricNote.definition: 进度/质量/技术状态三域加权综合评分,顶层健康度
metricNote.formula: 进度健康度 × 40% + 质量健康度 × 30% + 技术状态健康度 × 30%
metricNote.scope: 需三域子指标均有数据

sqlConfig.query: WITH p AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_due THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS due, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_milestone_node AND d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ms_ot, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_milestone_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ms_t, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_abnormal_pending AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abn, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_unchanged AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ov_unc FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]), q AS (SELECT SUM(new_issue_cnt) AS n, SUM(open_issue_cnt) AS o, SUM(zero_completed_cnt) AS z, SUM(no_zero_plan_cnt) AS np FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]), t AS (SELECT SUM(total_change_cnt) AS total, SUM(order_signed_cnt) AS sgn, SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii) AS unsgn, SUM(reform_done_i_ii) AS rd, SUM(reform_pending_i_ii) AS rp FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]), prog_h AS (SELECT ((CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE (p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END))*0.3) AS h FROM p), qual_h AS (SELECT ((CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE q.z::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END)*0.5+(CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE (q.n-q.np)::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE q.o::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END))*0.2) AS h FROM q), tech_h AS (SELECT ((CASE WHEN (t.sgn+t.unsgn)=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.sgn::numeric/(t.sgn+t.unsgn)::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN (t.rd+t.rp)=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.rd::numeric/(t.rd+t.rp)::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(100-(CASE WHEN t.total=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.unsgn::numeric/t.total::numeric*100 END))*0.2) AS h FROM t) SELECT ROUND((prog_h.h*0.4 + qual_h.h*0.3 + tech_h.h*0.3)::numeric, 2) AS "综合健康度" FROM prog_h, qual_h, tech_h

metricNote.definition: 综合 3 个进度子指标的加权评分,满分 100 分
metricNote.formula: 节点按时完成率 × 40% + 里程碑按时完成率 × 30% + (100 − 节点不正常率) × 30%
metricNote.scope: 需进度三项子指标均有数据;受顶部时间筛选器控制

sqlConfig.query: WITH p AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_due THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS due, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_milestone_node AND d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ms_ot, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_milestone_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ms_t, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_abnormal_pending AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abn, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_unchanged AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ov_unc FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]) SELECT ROUND((CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.on_time::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN p.ms_t=0 THEN 0 ELSE p.ms_ot::numeric/p.ms_t::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN p.due=0 THEN 0 ELSE (p.abn+p.ov_unc)::numeric/p.due::numeric*100 END))*0.3, 2) AS "进度健康分" FROM p

metricNote.definition: 综合 3 个质量子指标的加权评分,满分 100 分
metricNote.scope: 需质量三项子指标均有数据

sqlConfig.query: WITH q AS (SELECT SUM(new_issue_cnt) AS n, SUM(open_issue_cnt) AS o, SUM(zero_completed_cnt) AS z, SUM(no_zero_plan_cnt) AS np, SUM(open_cat_design) AS d FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]) SELECT CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(q.z::numeric/q.n::numeric*100,2) END AS "归零率", ROUND((CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE q.z::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END)*0.5+(CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE (q.n-q.np)::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END)*0.3+(100-(CASE WHEN q.n=0 THEN 0 ELSE q.o::numeric/q.n::numeric*100 END))*0.2,2) AS "质量健康分" FROM q

metricNote.definition: 综合签署率/整改率/未签署比率得出的健康度评分
metricNote.formula: 签署完成率 × 40% + 整改落实率 × 40% + (100 − 未签署比率) × 20%
metricNote.scope: 需技术状态三项子指标均有数据

sqlConfig.query: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(total_change_cnt) AS total, SUM(new_cat_i) AS cat_i, SUM(order_signed_cnt) AS signed, SUM(order_unsigned_cat_i)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_ii)+SUM(order_unsigned_cat_iii) AS unsigned, SUM(reform_done_i_ii) AS reform_done, SUM(reform_pending_i_ii) AS reform_pending FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 WHERE period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND project_no = {{projectNo}}]]) SELECT ROUND((CASE WHEN (t.signed+t.unsigned)=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.signed::numeric/(t.signed+t.unsigned)::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(CASE WHEN (t.reform_done+t.reform_pending)=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.reform_done::numeric/(t.reform_done+t.reform_pending)::numeric*100 END)*0.4+(100-(CASE WHEN t.total=0 THEN 0 ELSE t.unsigned::numeric/t.total::numeric*100 END))*0.2,2) AS "技术状态健康分" FROM t

SELECT s.period_month AS "月份", SUM(s.new_issue_cnt) AS "新增问题", SUM(s.zero_completed_cnt) AS "归零完成", SUM(s.open_issue_cnt) AS "现存问题" FROM biz_dws_quality_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND s.project_no = {{projectNo}}]] GROUP BY s.period_month ORDER BY s.period_month

SELECT SUM(s.high_cnt) AS "高风险", SUM(s.mid_cnt) AS "中风险", SUM(s.low_cnt) AS "低风险" FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND s.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

SELECT SUM(s.new_cat_i) AS "I类更改", SUM(s.new_cat_ii) AS "II类更改", SUM(s.new_cat_iii) AS "III类更改" FROM biz_dws_tech_state_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND s.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

风险总数.definition: 周期内提出的风险总数(高+中+低)
风险总数.formula: 风险提出时间在[开始日期,结束日期]内的风险计数
风险总数.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

高风险.definition: 风险等级为'高'的风险总数
高风险.formula: 风险等级='高' 的风险计数
高风险.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

中风险.definition: 风险等级为'中'的风险总数
中风险.formula: 风险等级='中' 的风险计数
中风险.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

低风险.definition: 风险等级为'低'的风险总数
低风险.formula: 风险等级='低' 的风险计数
低风险.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

已释放.definition: 目前状态为'已释放'(已闭环)的风险数
已释放.formula: 风险状态='已释放' 的风险计数

未释放.definition: 目前状态为'未释放'的风险总数
未释放.formula: 风险状态='未释放' 的风险计数

sqlConfig.query: SELECT SUM(s.total_risk_cnt) AS "风险总数", SUM(s.high_cnt) AS "高风险", SUM(s.mid_cnt) AS "中风险", SUM(s.low_cnt) AS "低风险", SUM(s.released_cnt) AS "已释放", SUM(s.open_cnt) AS "未释放" FROM biz_dws_risk_monthly_v2 s WHERE s.period_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND s.period_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND s.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND s.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]

按时完成.definition: 周期内在计划时间内完成的节点数
按时完成.formula: 完成情况='按时完成' 的节点计数
按时完成.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

超期完成.definition: 周期内超过计划时间但已完成的节点数(含已变更/未变更)
超期完成.formula: 完成情况∈('超期已完成已变更','超期已完成未变更') 的节点计数
超期完成.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

未完成.displayName: 项目本周期节点未完成总数
未完成.definition: 周期内处于未完成状态的节点总数
未完成.formula: 状态为'不正常待变更'+'超期未完成未变更'+'超期未完成已变更'的节点计数
未完成.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

正常待完成.definition: 节点计划时间未到、状态正常的节点数
正常待完成.formula: 完成情况='正常待完成' 的节点计数
正常待完成.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制

异常.definition: 处于异常状态(不正常待变更 + 超期未完成未变更)的节点数
异常.formula: 完成情况∈('不正常待变更','超期未完成未变更') 的节点计数
异常.scope: 受顶部时间筛选器控制,不含一般节点

sqlConfig.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_on_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "按时完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_completed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "超期完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_incomplete THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "未完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_pending_normal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "正常待完成", SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_abnormal_pending AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_overdue_unchanged AND NOT d.is_general_node THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "异常" FROM biz_dwd_project_node_v2 d WHERE d.plan_month >= to_char({{dateFrom}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') AND d.plan_month <= to_char({{dateTo}}::date, 'YYYY-MM') [[AND d.dept = {{deptId}}]] [[AND d.project_no = {{projectNo}}]]
